notes.title: Quarantine Zone | Demo Post-Release News Update
notes.notes:
Greetings!

First of all, we'd like to celebrate the fact that more than [b]400.000[/b] people have played [b]Quarantine Zone[/b] Demo!

We know of players' frustration with the resource cart, its controls & resource transportation. We are already working on addressing your concerns thanks to the ample feedback we've received on the matter.

With that being said, we also keep a keen eye on all other feedback regarding other parts of the game, including bug reports.

We ask that you give us time to figure out a proper way to address the resource cart and we'll keep improving other aspects of the demo.

Thank you for playing the demo! We'll be back with more news during the upcoming week.

Make sure you’ve joined our official subreddit and Discord server:
[b]Quarantine Zone[/b] on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/QuarantineZoneGame/]Reddit[/url]
[b]Quarantine Zone[/b] on [url=https://discord.gg/quarantinezonegame]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Quarantine Zone Demo Patch #1
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

We'd like to thank everyone for playing the demo and reporting your issues to us.

We've prepared the first patch addressing some of the issues, including critical ones.

[h1]Patchnotes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added an option in the Setting Menu to toggle on/off Motion Blur
[*] Fixed a commonly faced crash issue with people with specs within hardware requirements
[*] Fixed error that blocks the controls after dying on a drone
[*] Visual improvements to UI
[*] Fixed 'Lost Signal' Bug
[*] Fixed bug when switching between weapons during defence
[*] After finishing the evacuation sorting the PC now shows that the evacuation is ready 
[*] When finishing the sorting process, i.e. sending survivor to quarantine/liquidation/evacuation block the Tablet UI will now close automatically
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]
